claim_boundary: This artifact records convention and conservation/exchange decision criteria. It does not derive a scalar EOM, T_Psi_mu_nu, divergence relation, or exchange law.

candidate_convention_packet.matter_coupling_policy: decoupled pilot target with g_Psi = 0 until L_int exists

route_options.description: Psi is treated as a formal or bookkeeping variable only.
route_options.not_allowed_claim: physical scalar field or new mediator
route_options.required_next_artifact: convention packet plus null spectator fixture

route_options.description: Psi is treated as a physical field with observable map.
route_options.required_next_artifact: field normalization, EOM, T_Psi_mu_nu, observable map, and external-constraint route

route_options.description: No explicit exchange is claimed while L_int and lambda_T are zero or absent.
route_options.allowed_claim: future divergence target under restricted decoupled assumptions
route_options.required_next_artifact: scalar EOM, metric variation, divergence calculation, and boundary conditions

route_options.description: Individual sectors exchange via explicit currents while total accounting closes.
route_options.required_next_artifact: donor/receiver sector list, J_a^nu definitions, sign conventions, dimensions, and total-exchange sum

use_conservation_not_exchange_only_if: future divergence calculation is explicitly pending
use_explicit_exchange_only_if: donor and receiver sectors are independently defined
sum of exchange currents is shown to balance
recipient sector has an observable signature
hold_if: conservation is asserted without divergence calculation
no-exchange prose coexists with source/sink language
mostly-plus convention is treated as physical correctness
symbolic V(Psi) is treated as specified

safe_wording: Decoupled conservation is a first-pass target under restricted assumptions, not a derived conservation law. Psi remains a candidate bookkeeping/scalar-route symbol until physical interpretation is separately derived and reviewed.
